name: NEXTDC D1 Darwin Data Centre
notes: NEXTDC lists D1 in the Darwin CBD with 3,000 m2 technical space and 1MW+ IT capacity; NT investment case study says the A$80m facility was switched on in August 2024 and uses domestic and subsea connectivity.

name: NEXTDC D2 Darwin Data Centre
notes: NEXTDC describes D2 Darwin as in development in Darwin CBD, adding 6MW of capacity with Tier IV target certification; DCD reported it had topped out and was scheduled for completion in 1HFY27.

name: DXN SDC Darwin
notes: DXN's SDC Darwin page identifies the Secure Data Centre in Darwin CBD at 27 Harvey St as a commercially available stand-alone Tier 3-built data warehousing and colocation facility that commenced trading in 2004.

name: Area9 Darwin Data Centre
notes: Area9 says its data centre is located in Darwin in the Northern Territory and provides a fully redundant, high-availability facility with a dedicated disaster recovery site connected by dark fibre.

name: DCI Darwin DRW01 Data Centre
notes: DCD reported DCI secured a 2.7 ha site at Darwin Technology Park in Wishart for a Tier III-ready 10MW DRW01 edge facility, with an option to expand to 5 ha. Division assignment follows Wishart/Litchfield area geography.

name: Beetaloo Digital Weddell Data Centre Precinct
notes: NT Territory Coordinator says Beetaloo Digital has a 12-month exclusive commitment over a 185 ha Weddell site for feasibility and approvals; proposal includes up to 2GW on-site gas power supporting up to two hyperscale campuses for AI/cloud/data processing and up to A$40bn private investment. Confirmed IT load has not been published.

name: Joint Defence Facility Pine Gap data centre
developer: Australian Department of Defence / United States Government contractors
notes: Nautilus Institute report identifies Pine Gap outside Alice Springs as a major technical intelligence facility and references HVAC responsibility covering the facility's data center; a current Amentum role references structured cabling for data center network, server, storage, security and facility infrastructure at Joint Defense Facility Pine Gap. Included as a specialised defence/government data centre rather than commercial colocation.
